facts.fact: NIRA completed the migration of more than 28 million records to its new MOSIP-based identity platform and added about 6.7 million new registrations, issuing new IDs.
facts.system: NIRA national identity platform on MOSIP

facts.fact: NIRA deduplicated multiple biometric databases during the migration and found about 200,000 duplicates over about seven months.
